name: nutrition-app-functions
description: Secure backend (Firebase Cloud Functions) proxying OpenAI for the nutrition app. Never expose the OpenAI key or call OpenAI from the Flutter client — see Instrucciones.md sections 19-38, 75.

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.test:rules: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-nutrition-app "node --test test-build/test/rules/firestore.rules-spec.js"
